title: Late deliverable service-recovery reply

job.buyer: Client-service manager at a research consultancy
job.request: Draft a service-recovery reply after a delayed report, using the incomplete investigation record without over-promising compensation.

source_documents.text:
CLIENT COMPLAINT
The final evaluation report was promised for 14 August.
It had not arrived by 18 August.
The client says the delay disrupted an internal board pack and asks for a 25% fee reduction.

INTERNAL NOTE
Draft report was complete on 13 August.
A data-quality concern was raised during final QA on 14 August.
The project lead delayed release while two source tables were checked.
Investigation is not complete: we do not yet know whether the source tables contain an error.
No compensation has been authorised.

RESPONSE INSTRUCTION
Acknowledge the missed date.
Explain that a data-quality issue triggered additional review without implying the client caused it.
State that the compensation request has been recorded and will be considered after the facts are confirmed.
Give the client a next update by 20 August.

constraints: Do not say the source tables were wrong; the investigation is incomplete.
Do not promise the requested 25% reduction.
Acknowledge the missed 14 August delivery date.
Give 20 August as the next update date.

prohibited_inventions.label: unconfirmed error
patterns: we found an error in the source tables
